title: HIM - Specialist
description:
Position Title: Health Information Management (HIM) Specialist
Professional Type: Allied Health Professional
Contract Type: Long-Term (13 Weeks)
Shift: Day Shift | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM | 40 Hours/Week
Compensation: $16.75 – $18.00 per hour

Notes:
Local candidates only
Temp to hire.

Position Summary:
The HIM Specialist is responsible for processing requests for medical records and itemized bill copies in a timely, accurate, and efficient manner. This role requires a strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and delivering high-quality customer service in accordance with applicable federal and state regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process requests for medical records and itemized billing with precision and promptness

  • Ensure compliance with all federal and state release of information regulations

  • Maintain confidentiality and uphold HIPAA guidelines

  • Communicate effectively with patients, providers, and third-party requestors

  • Utilize EMR systems such as EPIC for document retrieval and processing

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • 2–3 years of clerical experience in a healthcare setting

  • Previous experience working in a medical office or HIM department

  • Proficiency with EMR systems, preferably EPIC

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Familiarity with federal and state ROI (Release of Information) regulations

title: RN - Case Manager
description:
Position Title: Registered Nurse – Case Manager
Professional Type: Registered Nurse (RN)
Specialty: Case Management

Contract Details:
Type: Long-Term Assignment
Duration: 13 Weeks
Shift: Day Shift | 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Hours: 40 hours per week
Rate: $70.00 – $75.00/hr

Position Summary:
In collaboration with the patient/family, physicians, and the interdisciplinary team, the Case Manager facilitates the patient's progression through the acute episode of care in an efficient and cost-effective manner.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Monitoring level of care

  • Initiating evidence-based protocols and order sets

  • Influencing progression of care

  • Facilitating navigation through the acute care episode

  • Proposing an appropriate transition plan within 48 hours of admission

The Case Manager also serves as an advocate for the patient and family throughout the entire episode of care.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN) required

    • A combination of relevant education and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in one of the following:

    • Acute care Case Management, or

    • Utilization Management at an acute care facility and/or insurance company (in UR or CM roles)

  • General knowledge and experience with InterQual criteria (Preferred)

  • Active Pennsylvania RN license required

  • Certified Case Manager (CCM) preferred

Travel is a key component of this role—the candidate must have a reliable personal vehicle. While the primary office is located in Farmington, CT, frequent travel to Glastonbury, Hartford, Plainville, Avon, and Cheshire is required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide clinical support including patient intake, vital signs, and assisting with procedures

Requirements:

  • Minimum 1 year of recent Medical Assistant experience (required)

  • Experience in a surgical office setting (preferred)

  • Familiarity with Epic EMR (preferred)

title: Social Worker - Transplant
description:
Professional Type: Social Worker
Specialty: Transplant
Contract Type: Long-Term Assignment (13 Weeks)
Shift: Days | 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM | 40 Hours/Week
Pay Rate: $55.00 – $60.00/hr (based on experience)

Position Overview

We are seeking a qualified and compassionate Transplant Social Worker for a full-time, long-term contract position. The Social Worker will provide direct clinical services to transplant patients and their families, supporting them through evaluation, education, and psychosocial care throughout the transplant process.

This role includes:

  • Evaluating patients' appropriateness for transplant

  • Educating patients and families on the transplant process

  • Assessing needs for psychosocial intervention

  • Providing referrals, intermittent counseling, and crisis intervention as needed

  • Coordinating referrals to community resources

  • Serving as a department resource on psychosocial services, policies, and best practices

Requirements

  • Master's Degree in Social Work, Social Services, or a related field.

  • Licensure:

    • PA Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or Licensed Social Worker (LSW).

    • Must obtain PA Social Worker License within 2 years of hire, if not already held.

  • Experience:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience as a Transplant Social Worker in an outpatient setting.
    • OR
  • Equivalent hospital-based transplant social work experience, with demonstrated transplant-specific responsibilities (Required)

  • Preferred Certification:

    • Oncology Social Work Certification (OSW-C) preferred

title: RN - ICU
description:
Professional Type: Registered Nurse (RN)
Specialty: Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
Contract Type: Long-Term Assignment (13 Weeks)
Shift: Days | 7:00 AM – 7:30 PM | 36 Hours/Week
Pay Rate: $55.00 – $60.00/hr (based on experience)

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced ICU Registered Nurse for a 13-week day shift assignment. The RN will provide high-quality, patient-centered care in the Intensive Care Unit, with an expected nurse-to-patient ratio of 1:3. While primary responsibilities will be in the ICU, the RN may be floated to Stepdown and Med/Surg units as needed, but will not float to other critical care units.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care based on individualized needs and physician directives

  • Collaborate with physicians, interdisciplinary teams, patients, and families to deliver comprehensive care

  • Provide clinical oversight and direction to nursing support staff

  • Maintain compliance with standards of nursing practice, hospital policies, and departmental procedures

Clinical Skills & Procedures

Must be experienced and comfortable with the following, including but not limited to:

  • A-line monitoring

  • Bair Hugger System

  • FMS Systems

  • IV Insulin and IV Infusion/Endoscopy

  • Stable DKA management

  • IPAP and Non-Invasive Ventilation

  • Telemetry monitoring

  • Peripheral catheter withdrawals

  • Nurse Collect Unit – No phlebotomy required

Requirements

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing (Required)

  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (Preferred)

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in ICU or relevant clinical specialty (Preferred)

  • Active PA or Multistate Compact RN License (Required)

  • Basic Life Support (BLS).
